mapper.select: SELECT m.BATCH_SEQ AS batchSeq, m.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket, t1.secAcctId, t2.ps AS ps, t3.termType AS termType, m.FEE_TYPE AS feeType, m.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType, m.CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, m.EFF_DATE as effDate, m.CHARGE_BASIS as chargeBasis, m.FEE_MAXI as feeMaxi, m.FEE_MINI as feeMini, m.CHARGE_VALUE as chargeValue, m.CHARGE_RATE * 1000 as chargeRate, m.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE as isPayWithTrade FROM ( select BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE,CHARGE_BASIS,T1.FEE_MAXI,t1.FEE_MINI,T1.CHARGE_VALUE,t1.CHARGE_RATE,t.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE from TRD_FEE_CONFIG t inner join TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL t1 on t.SEQ_NO=t1.CONFIG_SEQ_NO where t.FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05') GROUP BY t.BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET , FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE,CHARGE_BASIS,T1.FEE_MAXI,t1.FEE_MINI,T1.CHARGE_VALUE,t1.CHARGE_RATE,t.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE ) m INNER JOIN ( select n.BATCH_SEQ,LISTAGG(DISTINCT n.sec_acct_id, ',')as secAcctId from TRD_FEE_CONFIG n where n.FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05') GROUP BY n.BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t1 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t1.BATCH_SEQ INNER JOIN ( select BATCH_SEQ,LISTAGG(DISTINCT ps, ',') as ps from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05') GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t2 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t2.BATCH_SEQ INNER JOIN ( select BATCH_SEQ,LISTAGG(DISTINCT TERM_TYPE, ',') as termType from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05') GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t3 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t3.BATCH_SEQ where m.BATCH_SEQ = #{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
